name: caslon
description: Reconstructed from William Caslon's 1734 specimen sheet (McGill University Library copies, 600 ppi). Each glyph is the registered average of every impression on three copies; spacing solved from printed neighbours. 1000 units = measured Pica body.
_why: Reproduces Caslon 1734/scripts as published (v1.0). win_meta is off because release_names.py applies the Windows fixes afterwards.
